title: Magna Specialty Steel (MSS)
contentHtml:
Magna Specialty Steet (MSS) is a cutting-edge steel manufacturing unit specializing in alloy, stainless, and super-specialty ingots. Established in 2023 in Pune, India, MSS is proud to be part of the globally recognized Worldwide Oilfield Machine (WOM) group—an industry leader since 1980 with diversified operations across Oil & Gas, International Defense, and Railways.

At MSS our mission is simple yet bold: to produce the cleanest, highest-quality steel—from carbon and alloy to duplex and super duplex—meeting the most rigorous global standards. With a relentless focus on quality, precision, and timely delivery, we’ve become a trusted supplier for high-tech sectors such as oilfield services, petrochemicals, defense, and rail transport.

Our advanced steel melting unit enables us to manufacture a wide range of ingots, including precipitation-hardening stainless steels and other super-specialty grades. Backed by innovative technology and an expert team, we are proud to fuel industrial growth with materials that meet the evolving demands of a rapidly advancing world.

At Magna Specialty Steel, steel isn’t just a product—it’s the backbone of progress.

title: WOM BOP Cunningham Facility
contentHtml: In 1994, WOM introduced its drilling pressure control manufacture and repair facility in Houston, Texas. The Cunningham facility has 55,000 square feet of manufacturing and office space on 11 acres of land. This business unit expansion leveraged WOM’s existing product offering into the BOP Pressure Control market. This facility specializes in Annular, Ram Type BOPs and proprietary engineered elastomers. The Cunningham location is an API 16A certified facility with the ability to complete new BOP’s and API 16AR repair/remanufacture. We can achieve different levels of repair according to customer requirements – First Class, Working Class or Combination Class. Customers can expect quick turnaround on repair with a readily available stock of BOP’s and spare parts. Our expansion of the Magnum BOP R&D Technology Center has allowed further extended capabilities of API 16A 4th Edition PR2 validation testing. The Cunningham location is more than a convenience for our customers it is a necessity for the ever demanding industry.

title: WOM Middle East Dubai
contentHtml:
WOM Middle East was established in 1999 at Dubai, United Arab Emirates as a part of WOM global expansion strategy to better serve our customers operating in the Middle East, North Africa & CIS regions.

Initially operating out of a 60 Sq. mtr.  office based in DAFZA, Dubai and later relocating to JAFZA, Dubai, WOM ME has undergone exponential development in the past two decades. Today WOM ME is located inside the Jebel Ali Free Zone (Dubai -UAE), in 36,000 m2 facility includes a full-fledged API Product Manufacturing & Refurbishment facility, equipped with hydro test bay, a huge (540 M3) gas pressure-test pit capable of testing up to 30,000 psi and a world class training center.

Serving as the focal point for all WOM product line & services in the region, WOM ME support our customers with our versatile capabilities which include API 6A Wellhead & Tree Equipment, API 16A Drill-through Equipment, API 16C Choke & Kill Equipment, 2014/68/EU Directive Pressure Equipment etc. and by maintaining the highest level certifications in Quality (ISO 9001:2015) and Health, Safety & Environment (ISO 45001:2018).

title: Magnum Forge & Machine Works
contentHtml:
Magnum Forge is a manufacturer of open die and closed die forgings, engaged in manufacturing Oilfield and Power Transmission Components in various grades like low and medium carbon steel, alloy steel, stainless steel, Inconel, 17-5PH, duplex and super duplex.

The plant is ISO 9001 and PED 97/23/EC certified and fortified with experienced technocrats. The management and workforce of Magnum Forge maintain strict quality control procedures that conform to the standards set by the industry in which the product will be used. The plant has an annual capacity to forge more than 25,000 tons, ensuring quick delivery and competitive pricing.

Magnum Forge not only provides highest quality forgings, but also has significantly contributed in cutting down the delivery time. Close Die Forging capabilities helped WOM reduce delivery time by SIX weeks.
